data.one_liner: Cross‑platform WebSocket client with auto‑reconnect, ping measurement and typed message support
data.what_it_does: Provides a unified WebSocket API for web, mobile and desktop. It handles connection state, ping/pong, auto‑reconnect and offers a generic message processor for typed payloads.
use_when: Any scenario needing reliable WebSocket communication across platforms
avoid_when: Simple one‑off WebSocket usage where a lightweight library is sufficient
Projects that already use a dedicated WebSocket client like web_socket_channel
strengths: Stream‑based API for easy integration with async code
weaknesses: Not as widely used as web_socket_channel, so community support is smaller
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, import package, create handler and listen to streams – no extra build_runner or permissions needed

alternatives.name: web_socket_channel
alternatives.why_pick_it: Lightweight, widely used, no extra dependencies, good for simple WebSocket needs
